text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Canary rollout 'model-vv3' (eu-west) error-rate spiking: 5xx up ~7% over baseline, latency p95 doubled. Triggering on-call: @riley. See /alerts/1805032123 and grafana: https://grafana.redwood/model-rollouts

riley: on it. Acknowledging. Anyone see user-facing reports? :eyes:

cs-rep: got a thread from customer-412 reporting degraded completions and timeouts starting ~04:05 UTC. They see lots of empty responses.

mike: looks like canary pods are OOM-ing then restarting, per k8s events. Logs show: 
```
E tensorflow: allocation failed: out of memory
... traceback truncated
```
Suspect quantized kernel regressions in vv3 build.

sasha: if pods are flapping we should pull the rollout and flip the feature flag. Recommend feature flag kill and then manual rollback to model-vv2.

riley: agreed. Plan: 1) flip flag `model_eu_canary` -> false (instant traffic route to stable) 2) if traffic doesn't normalize, trigger manual rollback of canary allocation 3) verify via smoke and sampling. Mike can you handle the flag flip? I'll coordinate rollback if needed.

mike: flipping flag now. `FLAG_OPS: toggle model_eu_canary false --env=eu-west`

incident-bot: FLAG_CHANGE: model_eu_canary set to false by mike at 04:08:13 UTC. Notifying routing service.

riley: monitoring ingestion. Traffic started shifting, errors dropping to ~3%

mike: logs show routing migrated ~60% of requests off canary. Keep watching.

sasha: if we still see instability at 90% shifted, we should execute manual rollback of canary deployment to previous image (`model-server:vv2-stable`). Command: `kubectl set image deployment/model-canary model-server=model-server:vv2-stable -n prod-eu` — riley, want me to prep the command?

riley: prep and I'll apply if needed. Also open a canary rollback ticket in JIRA for postmortem.

jordan: sending quick smoke scripts to exec into a sample pod and run `curl -sS /v1/health` and a generation sample. Putting commands here: 
```
kubectl exec -it deploy/model-stable -c server -n prod-eu -- curl -sS localhost:8080/health
kubectl exec -it deploy/model-stable -c server -n prod-eu -- curl -sS -X POST localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

mike: after flag flip error-rate down to 1.2% and p95 back to baseline. Customer 412 updated: "latency improving".

cs-rep: Customer 412 confirms improvement at 04:12 UTC. Thanks team.

riley: since traffic and stability are good, I'm holding off on manual rollback. We'll keep the flag off and continue monitoring for 30m. Postmortem to include test coverage for vv3 quantized kernels.

sasha: creating an incident tracking task: INVESTIGATE-180503 - root cause analysis for model-vv3 canary regression and rollout gating rules.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Pager cleared. Escalation window 30m.

mike: leaving note: if errors reappear when we reenable canary, do not redeploy vv3 to canary without kernel fallback or reduced batch sizes.

riley: Agreed. I'll follow up with Deploy and Runtime teams to coordinate a safe re-onboard checklist. Marking this thread resolved for page but keeping incident open for RCA. :white_check_mark:
